en:
But... they cut you open during surgery, right?
It's so scary. I don't wanna get hurt...
Understandable. Nobody likes getting hurt.
They said I'm gonna die if I don't do it, though.

And if that happens, I'd never see
Ono Michio-kun again.
Oh, right. You like Michio-kun, huh?

Yeah, he's the best! He even protected
me back at that talk show event!
Someday, I'm gonna marry him!
Huh, that's quite the statement.

I remember now.
This is that girl from the event.

If I don't get that surgery, I can't marry Michio-kun.
But I'm not brave enough... I'm so scared.

I need to help this girl face her fears.
I thought I was out... but I have to do this.

Okay, just wait here a little bit.
I have a friend who might want to meet you.
A friend?

That's right.
I think you're really gonna like him.

Trust me, kid.
He'll help you face your fears.

You really mean it? Okay, I'll wait!
My name's Shizuko, by the way.

Shizuko, huh? All right Shizuko,
my friend will be here soon. Hold on tight.

It looks like I need to become Ono Michio
one last time and help this girl out.
I should get in touch with Hironaka.
Hellooo?

Kiryu-san! Is everything okay?
Don't tell me, you want to be Michio-kun again!?

Believe it or not, yeah.
I need to borrow the costume for a bit.
You're more than welcome to, Kiryu-san!

I'm over at the Onomichi Yonetoku right now.
Would you mind dropping by here?
Yonetoku? All right, see you soon.
Oh, Kiryu-san! So good to see you!
Hey there. How have things been going?

Very well! Thanks to you, Ono Michio-kun's
popularity has shot up nationwide!

I'm working nonstop around the clock to bring
the PR attention back to Onomichi itself!

Glad to hear you're happy.
By the way, about today...

You wanted to borrow the Michio-kun costume, right?
Look, I've got him here with me.
Mm, thanks.

I've gotta ask though, what's up?
I thought you were done with Michio-kun...

Well, there's this Michio fan who needs some help.
She needs to go under the knife, but she's afraid.

So I was thinking... maybe Michio would
be able to convince her it's a good idea.

Ahhh, that's a noble cause.
All right then, let's get you suited up!

I guess we should head over there first.
You can change once we're closer, okay?

Mmm, it really fits you so perfectly.
It's like you were born to wear this costume.
It's still hot, heavy, and hard to breathe in...
You know, this is a real thrill.

The character I made...
It might give hope to a little girl in need.
Seeing one of your creations come to life like that...

For us in the entertainment business,
there's simply no higher honor.

Yup. Now please, go help that girl out.
Not just for her, but for me, too.

You don't have to tell me twice.
Don't you know who I am?
I'm the pride of Onomichi... Ono Michio!

Damn right you are.
Now, get on out there-michi!
Leave it to michi!
Shizuko-chan. Hello-michi.
Whoaaa, it's Michio-kun!

Ahh! This is the best!
What are you doing here?

Well, um... My friend Kiryu-san told me
you were in trouble over here.

That old guy was friends with Michio-kun!?
Wow, so cool!

I'm here today to give you a bit
of courage for the future, Shizuko.
Courage?

That's right. Kiryu-san told me you're going
to be having surgery soon?

Y-Yeah. I'm really scared, though.
It's gonna hurt...
I guess I can't argue with that...

I don't wanna get hurt...
Michio-kun, aren't you... scared of pain?
Me? Hm...
Actually, pain doesn't scare me at all.

Of course. I'm Ono Michio, the pride of Onomichi.
Something like that could never stagger me.

You're so cool, Michio-kun.
I wish I was strong like you... but I'm scared.

...Pride won't get me anywhere.
I should try to relate to Shizuko.
Oh, that was just a lie. To be honest...

Oh, did I make you uncomfortable?
Sorry about that, Michio-kun.
...I should give her a real answer.
That was just a joke. To be honest...
Yeah. Pain really scares me, too.

Huh? You are, Michio-kun?
Even though you're so strong?

Of course. Every day, I try to figure
out the best way to avoid pain.

But sometimes, life forces you to push ahead
and keep moving forward, even though it hurts.

Why push ahead, though?
Can't you just run away?

Well, that's always an option.
In fact, it might lead to a relatively easy life.

But if you always run from pain, you might
outrun your dreams, too. And hurt those around you.

Hm, think back to the talk show event.
Remember those punks that got in the way?

If I hadn't taken it upon myself to fight them,
all you kids might've gotten badly hurt.

Yeah. I'm glad you were there to protect me,
Michio-kun. You kept me safe.

That fight wasn't easy, though.
Getting punched like that is really painful.
Oh... I see...

But as much as it hurt, it would have hurt even
more to see you all attacked. That's why I fought.
Think of your surgery the same way.

If you don't get this surgery and end up dying,
how do you think your mommy and daddy would feel?
Well... Probably pretty sad...
Are you okay with making them sad, Shizuko?
No... I don't want that!

Right? If you're brave now, you can
protect them all from that sadness.
Do you understand what I'm telling you?
Yeah... I think so. Still, it's really scary.
Hm... I guess you're right...

Look who it is! I finally found ya,
y'mascot fuck!

Y'did a real number on us back there.
I ain't gonna forget that, y'dopey mascot!

I brought tonsa friends with me today, though.
It ain't gonna go the same this time 'round!
Yer ass is grass... Michio-kun!
M-Michio-kun! Let's run away!
No. I'm staying here.

There's so many of them, though!
They're gonna attack you, and hurt you real bad!

That doesn't matter.
You might get hurt if I turn tail now.

If it means keeping that from happening,
I'll push past every one of their punches.

Shizuko. I'm gonna muster up the courage
to fight back against these punks.
Watch carefully... You got that?

What're ya yappin' about!?
Y'scared of the beatdown we're dishin'? Huh?

I'm not afraid of brats like you. I could never
embarrass myself like that in front of a kid.
I'm the pride of Onomichi, Ono Michio.

I won't hold back.
Now if you're ready to die... come at me!
D-Damn, yer tough... This guy ain't dopey at all!
The only dopey ones are you fools.
You're okay! I'm so glad...!

That was nothing. It hurt,
but all it took was a little courage.

Shizuko... It's your turn now. Can you
muster up the courage to get that surgery?

Yeah. I... I'll do it!
It might hurt, but I'll push through!
I don't wanna make my family sad. And...
I still wanna marry you someday, Michio-kun!
Being my wife won't be an easy task, you know.

That's okay! I'll do whatever it takes!
I'll be brave for you!
That's the spirit, Shizuko.
Shizuko... I'm so proud of you.
I... I'm so glad...

All right, I'm gonna go now!
It might hurt, but I'm gonna try super hard!

Give it all you've got.
I'll be cheering you on every step of the way, Shizuko.
Oh, and here. It's a present from me!
Thank you, Shizuko.

Bye bye, Michio-kun!
Hey, can you tell Kiryu-san something for me?
Tell him... Thank you so much!

Yeah, I can manage that.
He'll be happy to hear it.

I really can't thank you enough.
Goodbye then.
That was great, Kiryu-san.
So... Is this your last Michio appearance?
That's what I was hoping...

Well, um... would you maybe consider
adding one more to the list?

After that girl has her surgery, I'm sure she'd
love it if Michio-kun was there to congratulate her.
...I'll consider it.

U-Um... Hey, Mister!
Can I get a minute of your time?

There's something I need t'ask ya.
What, um... What year is it?

Wellll, like, um...
I wanna know what year it is.

2016? Y'mean it!?
Y'really really mean it!?

Yesss! I actually did it!
So then... this is really a year in the past?

And this is what I was like a year ago?
Oh yeah, my boobs are totally smaller now!
What? What the hell are you saying?

Oh, sorry about that.
I went off on a tangent there.

The thing is, well... I just performed
a time leap from a year in the future!
A time leap?
Yup! I'm actually from the year 2017!
I don't understand.
Oh, did I not make it clear?

Okeydokey! Let me start by explaining the
difference between time travel and a time leap.
(What is she talking about...?)

A time leap is when your consciousness transfers
from one point in time to your body in another time.

As for time travel, it's more like when you
move through time with a machine or something.

For example, if a guy goes back a day in a time machine,
both him and the him from yesterday would be there.

Basically two of the same guy would
exist in the same place and time.

With a time leap, just his consciousness transfers
into his past body, so there's only one of him.
Well? Do y'get it now?
Yeah, I think I do.

In my case, my consciousness from 2017 has
come back a year to inhabit my 2016 body!

I didn't think I'd be able to leap a whole year!
I'm pretty damn awesome, huh?

Sure, I guess you could say that.
Well, sorry for holding you up.

Um, what? Don't leave!
Come back, Mister!

I just made a pretty spectacular claim.
Don't you like, have questions or something?
Nah, I'm all right.
Huh? Reallyyyyy?

If you insist.
I guess I can stick around a while.

Yay, thanks Mister!
Oh, and my name's Miku.

Gotcha! Kiryu-san, right?
I'm gonna go out on a limb here...

...But you don't believe I actually
time leaped just now, do ya?

You mean how you came back here from
the future? Of course I don't.

Then how can I convince ya
I'm telling the truth?

Well, I'm not sure you can.
Hmmm...

Actually, if you're really from 2017,
you know the future, right?
Does anything strange happen in the next year?

Strange? So like, something major?
Hm...

It's hard t'think of examples on the spot.
Can y'ask me something specific?
If I have to. Let's see...
Are there gonna be any serious natural disasters?

Ummm, I don't <font_kind=yakuza_italic>think</font_kind> so...?
There might be a few earthquakes...

Oh, there was one pretty interesting disaster!
My mom totally ran over my dad with her car.

He came out of it totally fine...
but ugh, my dad's so lame.

Hold on, I don't care about your family issues.
I want to know what the papers write about.

C'mon, nobody reads the papers nowadays.
We get news through our phones.

Oh yeah! We have these fancy things
called smartphones in 2017!
They were around in 2016, too...
Oh, yeah. I guess you're right!
Can you tell me who'll win the big horse races?

Oh, that makes sense! That would prove
I came from the future for sure!

I didn't think of it this time...
but I'll definitely remember for my next time leap!

Thanks a bunch!
Your idea's gonna make me real rich, Kiryu-san!

Wait, your next time leap?
That doesn't prove anything here.
Huhhh? But I can't answer your question now...
Where will I be a year from now?

How am I s'posed to know that?
I only just met ya, Kiryu-san.

Oh, maybe I could time leap forward a year!
Then I'd be able t'tell ya the answer!

Although, it might be hard telling you the truth
if things go south for you. Like if you die...

That's fine.
Just tell me whatever you see.

You're so calm about this.
I guess you don't believe in me at all, huh?

Hold on a sec. I just realized, nothing you say
can really prove you're from the future.

Don't you have any physical proof?
Something that's definitely from 2017?

Uhhh... Like, a newspaper dated in the future?
Or maybe a 100 yen coin?
Yeah, that would be more convincing.

I already told you though,
only my consciousness came back here.
So you can't prove it.

My words should be proof enough.
Just look me in the eyes and say you believe me!
All right, I believe you.
Huh? You mean it!?
Come on. You can't expect that to work.
Huh? But I told you so much!

I will say though, you don't really seem
like the kind of girl who'd pull a trick like this.
Ah, so you <font_kind=yakuza_italic>do</font_kind> believe me!

This would go on forever if I didn't.
I don't have that kind of time.
That's kinda rude...

Either way, you have a reason for coming back
to 2016, right? I should get out of your hair.
You know, you're actually pretty cute.

Huh? Where'd that come from?
Although, I'm kinda into older guys.
Even though I'm probably older than your father?
My dad? I don't wanna think about him now. <symbol=note_with_outline>

But... you might really be older than him, Kiryu-san.
Ugh, I'm just thinking of his face now!
